reason: The README clearly describes a web overlay for managing development projects by executing configured commands, controlling processes, monitoring file changes, and viewing persistent logs; human review is appropriate because it can execute and terminate local processes.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中管理开发项目，支持启动、停止、重启、热重载和实时日志查看。
summaries.en: Manage development projects in the DSH Web interface with start, stop, restart, hot-reload, and live log viewing controls.

capabilities: Stops and restarts project process trees
Watches project files and triggers automatic restarts
Reads and persists project logs and settings
Exposes same-origin REST endpoints for project control and log access
